item.title: Authentication Logs
item.description: Trustgrid records information for authentication attempts into the control plane. This information can be used to troubleshoot authentication issues or monitor for suspicious activity. Authentication logs are available by navigating to Operations > Authentication Logs. Authentication Logs Viewing authentication logs requires audits::read:user permissions. Successful logins from external identity providers are logged, but failed attempts are not.
